textRuns.value: Non-live and unreferenced files over time

Section 10.2: Non-live is min(NonLiveFileSize, UnreferencedFileSize) when the storage was listed, else NonLiveFileSize, an upper bound: the files that left the table and that the log still tracks, as far as the storage can still hold them. Unreferenced is UnreferencedFileSize less Non-live, a lower bound: the files that no non-live file explains. A VACUUM lowers both. The removal times are those of 10.4. A period shows the tables of its last collection day, each table once, from its latest collection of that day. Sizes are in units of 1,000 bytes.
